messages:
sasha: Heads-up — Eden (customer) reports p99 token latency spikes on their dedicated us-west-2 pool since ~09:40 UTC. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/tenants/eden/overview. p99 from ~120ms -> ~1.2s, small increase in timeouts. Can runtime/infra triage? cc @aj @leo :point_up:

aj: On it. Quick Q: is this only Eden's dedicated pool or pervasive across other dedicated/customers?

sasha: Only Eden's dedicated pool so far. They use model `redwood-13b-8k-quant`. Support opened ticket #EDN-1234 with request id samples.

leo: Hmm. Any recent deploys to us-west-2 before the spike?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployed runtime v2.13.0 to prod/us-west-2 at 09:35 UTC (sha: abcdef123).

maria: I'll grab a repro trace. Sasha — can you paste a sample request id and a minimal payload?

sasha: Sample req id: rq_0a9f7c2b. Minimal payload snippet:
```json
{"model":"redwood-13b-8k-quant","input":"Summarize the following...","max_tokens":256}
```
Also attaching the timeline from the customer: lots of short requests around 09:38-09:42.

aj: Running a quick stress on staging to reproduce:
```bash
runtest-bench --model redwood-13b-8k-quant --duration 5m --concurrency 50 --seq-len 512
```
Will post results in ~6m.

aj: Staging run done — reproduced p99 jump when KV cache miss rate > ~80%. Profiling points to contention in kv-cache mutex. Stack sample:
```
goroutine 129  runtime stack:
  kv-cache.go:142 +0x1a3
  kv-cache.go:86  +0x8f
  runtime/asm_amd64.s:1581 +0x1
```
Feels like our last change to cache eviction/locking in v2.13 touched this.

leo: I suspected that. I pushed a small locking-granularity change in a branch that reduces the mutex scope and adds a per-shard lock. Creating PR now.

leo: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3842 — description: reduce kv lock contended region + fallback path for cold-cache heavy workloads.

sasha: Customer asked for a temporary mitigation — can we route their traffic to a compatible FP16 variant to avoid the quantized path until we have the fix? They said failover is acceptable.

aj: I can add a routing exception to send eden tenant -> `redwood-13b-8k-fp16` on their dedicated pool. Command I will run:
```yaml
- update-route:
    tenant: eden
    route_to: redwood-13b-8k-fp16
    until: 1802402400  # unix ts
```
Doing it in 2m.

support-bot: support-bot: Notified Eden that we will perform a temporary failover to a compatible FP16 variant. They accepted.

maria: CI on PR passes unit and integration tests locally. If we can get a quick canary, we can have a fix out in ~2 hours.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for runtime v2.13.1 (kv-lock fix) to prod/us-west-2 at 10:20 UTC. Canary group: 5% of traffic. Monitor p99 and error-rate dashboards.

aj: Routing exception applied and confirmed. Eden's traffic should be served by `redwood-13b-8k-fp16` now. Will monitor for fallbacks/errors.

leo: I'll watch the canary metrics closely. If canary looks good for 30m, expand to 100% and then remove routing exception.

sasha: Thanks all. I'll keep the support channel posted and escalate if Eden sees anything odd. :thumbsup:

leo: quick note — follow-up issue to add telemetry on per-shard lock wait times: RUNTIME-459.

aj: Observability shows p99 back to ~130ms for Eden after failover. Keeping thread open for next updates.

maria: Will run a post-mortem write-up once we finish rollout.

leo: monitoring continues — will update in ~10m.
